title: The Reign of the Lord's Anointed

questions.question: Why do the nations do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 2:1 (ESV): "Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?"

questions.question: The kings of the earth set themselves against whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 2:2 (ESV): "...against the Lord and against his Anointed..."

questions.question: He who sits in the heavens does what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 2:4 (ESV): "He who sits in the heavens laughs; the Lord holds them in derision."

questions.question: The Lord said to me, "You are my what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 2:7 (ESV): "The Lord said to me, 'You are my Son; today I have begotten you.'"

questions.question: Blessed are all who take what in him?
questions.explanation: Psalm 2:12 (ESV): "Blessed are all who take refuge in him."

questions.question: What does the Lord hold them in?
questions.explanation: Psalm 2:4 (ESV): "...the Lord holds them in derision."

questions.question: I have set my King on Zion, my holy what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 2:6 (ESV): "As for me, I have set my King on Zion, my holy hill."

questions.question: Ask of me, and I will make the nations your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 2:8 (ESV): "Ask of me, and I will make the nations your heritage..."

questions.question: You shall break them with a rod of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 2:9 (ESV): "You shall break them with a rod of iron and dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel."

questions.question: Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 2:11 (ESV): "Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice with trembling."

questions.question: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish in the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 2:12 (ESV): "Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish in the way..."

questions.question: For his wrath is quickly what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 2:12 (ESV): "...for his wrath is quickly kindled."

questions.question: Let us burst their bonds apart and cast away their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 2:3 (ESV): "Let us burst their bonds apart and cast away their cords from us."

questions.question: The peoples plot in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 2:1 (ESV): "...and the peoples plot in vain?"

questions.question: Now therefore, O kings, be wise; be warned, O rulers of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 2:10 (ESV): "Now therefore, O kings, be wise; be warned, O rulers of the earth."

key_verse_text: Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
